clue.text: Complicated diagrams covering right time to make pancakes

indicators.note: covering means the rearranged letters wrap round the abbreviation for right
complicated suggests the word diagrams is tangled up into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone drawing elaborate diagrams around the proper hour for making pancakes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Complicated' rearranges DIAGRAMS into MADIGRAS, and 'covering' wraps that round R.
explanation.definitionFit: Shrove Tuesday, the carnival day before Lent, is traditionally pancake day.

clue.text: Blight on one yellow flower

parts.note: to blight is to mar or spoil
I is the Roman numeral one
gold is a yellow colour

explanation.surface: A disease attacking a yellow bloom.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a common garden plant with orange or yellow blooms.

clue.text: Hand over drugged cigarette, but not one of the drug tablets

indicators.note: but not tells us to leave something out of the cigarette word

parts.note: a reefer is a cannabis cigarette
E is slang for an ecstasy tablet

explanation.surface: Passing a joint along while refusing the pills.
explanation.walkthrough: 'but not' removes one E from REEFER.
explanation.definitionFit: To pass a matter on to someone else is to hand it over.

clue.text: On the rocks, and very arrogant about it

indicators.note: about it means the arrogant word goes round the abbreviation for very

parts.note: insolent means rude and arrogant

explanation.surface: Someone whose business has failed yet who is cocky about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about it' puts V inside INSOLENT. 'On the rocks' looks like a drink served with ice, but here it means financially ruined.
explanation.definitionFit: A bankrupt firm that cannot pay its debts is said to be in financial ruin.

clue.text: Violently rush about, showing anger about current measure

indicators.note: about means the anger word goes round the measure of current

parts.note: rage is fierce anger
an amp is the unit for measuring electric current

explanation.surface: A furious person charging around, angry about an electricity reading.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' is the container signal; 'Violently rush about' is a verb phrase, matching the verb sense of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To charge around wildly destroying things is to run riot.

clue.text: Timepiece paper set up

parts.note: the Sun is a British daily newspaper

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the word for set is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: laid means set down, as a table is laid

explanation.surface: A clock made of paper, put up on the wall.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a garden device that tells the hour by a shadow.

clue.text: King put away outstanding person

parts.note: GR stands for Georgius Rex, King George
to put away food is to eat it

explanation.surface: A monarch imprisoned a remarkable individual.
explanation.definitionFit: A famous, eminent figure is called one of the greats.

clue.text: Old man run out -a faux pas

indicators.note: out tells us a letter is dropped from the old man word

parts.note: gaffer is slang for an old man
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: An elderly man run out at cricket, which is an embarrassing blunder.
explanation.definitionFit: A social blunder or tactless mistake.

clue.text: New Yorker, perhaps, shows hesitation about a British writer

indicators.note: about means the hesitation sound goes round the rest

parts.note: er is the sound of hesitating
Laurence Sterne wrote Tristram Shandy

explanation.surface: A New York resident hesitating over a British author.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' is the container signal; 'New Yorker, perhaps' is a definition by example, signalled by 'perhaps'.
explanation.definitionFit: New York is on the US east coast, so its people are from the East.

clue.text: One husband's abandoned across the Channel

indicators.note: abandoned means the husband letter is left out of the word for across

parts.note: through can mean across, from one side to the other
H is the abbreviation for husband

explanation.surface: A husband has left his family to go to France.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abandoned' removes H from THROUGH. 'the Channel' looks like the English Channel; the definition is just a channel.
explanation.definitionFit: A long narrow open hollow or ditch for water is a channel.

clue.text: So-called king's coat sent back to America

indicators.note: sent back means the coat word is read backwards

parts.note: fur is an animal's coat
US is America

explanation.surface: A monarch's coat being returned to the USA.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sent back' turns FUR into RUF. William II of England was nicknamed Rufus, hence 'so-called'.
explanation.definitionFit: William II was known by this nickname, meaning red, for his ruddy face.

clue.text: Established nothing after worker provided policy statement

indicators.note: after means the established and nothing pieces follow the worker and provided pieces

parts.note: to man is to work, and a man is a worker
if means provided that
O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A firm set up from nothing by a worker produces a statement of policy.
explanation.definitionFit: A political party publishes its programme of intended policies before an election.

clue.text: Thug, one who fights irregularly, we hear

indicators.note: we hear means the word sounds like an irregular fighter

parts.note: a guerrilla fights in an irregular, unofficial force

explanation.surface: A violent man fights dirty, according to reports.
explanation.definitionFit: A brutish heavy or hired muscle is slang for a big ape.

clue.text: Unemotional person in charge — retired diver

indicators.note: retired means the diver word goes backwards

parts.note: the grebe is a diving water bird

explanation.surface: The man in charge is a retired deep-sea diver.
explanation.definitionFit: A cold, aloof person is likened to a floating mass of ice.

clue.text: Draw no water, make no waves

definitions.meaning: do not take water from a source in the ground, read literally
avoid causing trouble, do not interfere

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means do not interfere with something that is fine as it is.

clue.text: A party flower that's smooth and white

parts.note: Lab is short for the Labour Party
the aster is a daisy-like flower

explanation.surface: A political group's emblem is a flower that is sleek and pale.
explanation.definitionFit: Alabaster is a fine stone proverbial for smooth pale skin.

clue.text: Issue needing to be raised

parts.note: issue in the legal sense of offspring, who have to be brought up, not a matter needing to be brought up at a meeting

explanation.definitionFit: Offspring, which is what issue means in wills, are kids who must be brought up.

clue.text: The best people wanting Jack removed from the ground?

parts.note: jack and salt are both slang for a sailor
of can mean away from, as in a distance of
earth is the ground

explanation.surface: Fine folk lacking a sailor taken off the land.
explanation.definitionFit: A biblical phrase for decent, honest, good people.

clue.text: Business receiving attention — it could be automatic

indicators.note: receiving means the business word takes in the attention word

parts.note: a firm is a business
to give ear is to pay attention

explanation.surface: A company getting attention for something that could run by itself.
explanation.walkthrough: 'receiving' is the container signal; 'automatic' looks like an adjective but stands for a self-loading gun.
explanation.definitionFit: An automatic is a self-loading pistol or rifle.

clue.text: Any loch could be so calm

indicators.note: could be means these letters could form another word

explanation.surface: Any Scottish lake might be this peaceful.
explanation.definitionFit: Halcyon days are peaceful, tranquil times.

clue.text: Sailor provided with following list of duties

parts.note: tar is an old word for a sailor
if means provided that

explanation.surface: A seaman given the next set of chores.
explanation.definitionFit: A schedule of customs charges or taxes on goods.

clue.text: Electrical equipment girl has instruction to turn on and run

parts.note: Ada is a girl's name
PTO, please turn over, tells a reader to turn the page and go on
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A girl told how to switch on a device and run it.
explanation.definitionFit: A plug fitting lets a device connect to a different socket.

clue.text: The empty pen is liable to snap

indicators.note: empty means the word the loses its middle

parts.note: a sty is a pen for pigs

explanation.surface: A biro running out of ink is likely to break.
explanation.definitionFit: Irritable people are quick to bite your head off.

clue.text: A deep breath is all you can drag if you trail, finally

indicators.note: finally tells us to take the final letters of the words before it

explanation.surface: A smoker who lags behind takes a long drag.
explanation.walkthrough: The last letters of 'all you can drag if you trail' spell it out.
explanation.definitionFit: As much air as your chest can hold in one go.

clue.text: Around university, class is the place for discussion

indicators.note: Around means the class word goes round the university abbreviation

parts.note: a form is a school class

explanation.surface: University classes are where debates happen.
explanation.definitionFit: In ancient Rome the public square was where matters were debated.

clue.text: Nice, tasty concoction — a case of nothing being left

definitions.text: a case of nothing being left

indicators.note: a concoction is a mixture, so these letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A delicious mixture from Nice is a box where nothing remains.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nice' looks like the adjective or the French city; it is just fodder. The definition reads as nothing left over, but means no will was left.
explanation.definitionFit: Dying without a will is a situation where no estate was left by testament.

clue.text: River runs dry with the aid of this

definitions.text: dry with the aid of this

parts.note: the Aire is a river in Yorkshire
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A river running dry.
explanation.definitionFit: A clothes horse or rack is used to dry laundry.

clue.text: Raid that's never ending?

definitions.meaning: a raid is a sudden attack or incursion
an old phrase for forever, ay meaning always

explanation.definitionFit: A sortie or sudden attack into enemy territory.

clue.text: General Tom Thumb was one of the militia

definitions.meaning: the tiny showman billed by Barnum as General Tom Thumb was a very small man
an American colonial militiaman ready at short notice

explanation.definitionFit: American revolutionary militiamen were ready to fight at a moment's notice.
